description: The complete rules.arclint.yaml document ArcLint accepts. A repository ruleset carries runtime, scan, extends, zones, and rules; a Pattern distribution file carries the pattern header, zones, and rules. Every Rule is keyed by its Rule ID and carries exactly one assertion key; an entry with no assertion key is an Override of a Rule an extended Pattern distributes. Unknown keys are rejected everywhere.
